summary: The reported 32xH20 GLM-5.2-w4afp8 NIXL prefill failure could not be reproduced on the assigned single AMD gfx950 GPU without model weights. Current source already rejects the two legacy NSA prefill-CP flags through an existing passing regression and documents the replacement CUDA CP interface; the report's resource-tracker warnings occur after worker exit and provide no initiating traceback, so no issue-specific source correction is justified.

tests.what_was_measured: Current CLI rejects the reported --enable-nsa-prefill-context-parallel and --nsa-prefill-cp-mode options, plus four independent former CP option spellings; one test and six subtests passed.

Two boundary tests passed; two generic tests failed on the prepared HIP platform because intentional HIP prefill-CP rejection occurred before their CUDA-oriented assertions. This is recorded as a test portability limitation, not an upstream reproduction.

tests.command: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-84356a3e73b4/venv/bin/python reports/j-84356a3e73b4/raw/gpu_environment.log producer (seeded torch FP32 CPU/GPU matmul script)
tests.what_was_measured: One AMD Instinct MI350X was visible through ROCm 7.2; seeded FP32 matmul matched CPU with max absolute error 9.5367431640625e-06 and allclose rtol=atol=1e-4. This measures GPU availability only.

gpu_execution.evidence: reports/j-84356a3e73b4/raw/gpu_environment.log records AMD Instinct MI350X execution and a CPU-referenced FP32 matmul. No GLM/W4AFP8/distributed execution was performed.

remaining_limitations: The available GPU is one AMD gfx950, not 32 NVIDIA H20 GPUs.
GLM-5.2-w4afp8 and EAGLE draft weights were unavailable.
The 2-prefill/2-decode multi-node NIXL topology was unavailable.
The upstream report has no initiating traceback; leaked resource warnings only describe shutdown cleanup.
Current HIP source explicitly rejects prefill CP, so AMD execution cannot stand in for the reported CUDA path.
The tiny Llama fixture cannot validate GLM-5.2, W4AFP8, or distributed NIXL semantics and was not used as a substitute.
